observations.source_page: sources/freud_router_bit_feed_and_speed_for_cnc_20170822.txt line 74, table "RECOMMENDED* CHIP LOADS FOR FREUD CARBIDE TIPPED STRAIGHT AND PROFILE BITS ONLY", row 1/8", column MDF/Particle Board: .002"-.004"
observations.material_label: MDF/Particle Board (Freud Carbide Tipped Straight and Profile Bits chart)
observations.ap_rule: depth of cut equal to bit diameter; if 2xD reduce chipload by at least 25%; if 3xD reduce by at least 50%
observations.notes: Feeds contract P24a (2026-11-10). Parsed by script from the stored text of the sheet. The table is the sheet's second table, for carbide tipped straight and profile bits; it is of the straight series (`feeds::series::SERIES_RULES`): only a straight-flute tool reads it. The table prints no flute count (the sheet's formulas take the flute count as an input); the row carries 2, as the solid carbide rows of the same sheet do. The table prints no roughing or finishing split and names no operation, so the row sits under (pocket, roughing) (G3). The sheet says: "Carbide tipped bits should not be used to drill directly into the work piece."

The table prints no roughing or finishing split and names no operation, so the row sits under (pocket, roughing) (G3). The sheet says: "Carbide tipped bits should not be used to drill directly into the work piece."
